negativeControls.note: Added by a scratch negative-control harness, not by the validator: each control copies the published inputs to a temporary directory, applies one deliberate corruption and runs the validator with -Repository pointing there. Every control must make the validator exit non-zero.

prePublicationReview.method: Two independent read-only adversarial reviewers over the uncommitted draft: (1) triggers, observers, guards, drivers and contexts against the exact SDK headers; (2) V34->V35 fidelity, result semantics, cleanup and lineage.
corrected: script-issued triggers (TRG-RUN-FIXTURE-CMD, TRG-CANCEL-CMDCTX): guards stay armed until I52CTDA_FINISH, callback identity bound to the command name
02NO-M: TRG-MODIFY-CLOSE-REF-A no longer suppresses graphics; produces N-OBJ-OPEN and N-ENT-GFX; single BodyObserverId
C15N16N-SM: RR-DB removed; RR-PAYLOAD-DB is the only body observer, registered by the payload; origin instance must equal MARK-REGISTRATION
new column BodyObserverId (INV-BODY-OBSERVER); RG-ONESHOT is one instance per callback identity and suppresses self-caused nesting
04NO-S N-OBJ-MOD producer declared (SET-STAGE-S-IN-PRIMARY); INV-MARKER-PRODUCER added, object events must touch a watched object
RR-MANAGED-CMD registered by the driver through the managed module, not by BOOT
13A-SM: APPCTX-EXEC-01 and SA-LOCK legal context name the synchronous NX-APPCTX-SYNC entry
02NO-SM: CLN-BASE never reopens trigger-erased objects nor removes fenced reactors; VER-SM bound to the §164 definition (never opens F-REF-B)
CMDCTX marker binding fixed to the unique command pair enclosing EP-CMDCTX and its token
02NTA-ALL: CB-EXEC-01 nested in an aborting transaction is UNKNOWN (UNK-NESTED-IN-ABORT)
FP-AFFILIATION no longer selects commit/abort at runtime
RESULT-RULE-V35 is exhaustive (otherwise UNKNOWN); OBS-CANDIDATE-BOUNDARY (i)-false branch added
OBS-VISIBILITY defined for both pre-end states; callback-time comparison stated in RESULT-RULE-V35
INV-ERASE-TRIGGER-DISJOINT cited by the erase-trigger lineage clauses
composite cleanup: no double origin removal; CLEAN-APPCTX-LOCK-PROCESS includes CLEAN-APPCTX-PROCESS steps; erased disposable notifiers removed with openErased
minor: 09N-A single T-PRIMARY end, RG-DB-APPEND armed by its trigger, BOOT-01 in SA-TX-START legal context
prePublicationReview.validatorHardening: Checks added after the review: BODY-OBSERVER, MARKER-PRODUCER (object-aware), GUARD-TARGET, ERASE-TRIGGER-DISJOINT, UNKNOWN-RULE, LINEAGE-ROW-AGREEMENT.
